name: projects
title: Projects
description: Keeps a page for every project you're working on, from a trip you're planning to something you're building: its goal and what you might need to finish it. Kept current every night from your memory, calendar and tasks, and corrected by the dream. You get an email when a project is added or finished.

task.description: Nightly: keep a wiki page for each project the user is working on (goal, what they might need, coming up, lately) from memory, calendar and tasks.
